greeting.speaker: Elder Guardian
greeting.text: Welcome, young ninja! I sense great potential within you. The path ahead is dangerous, but I can guide you.

tutorial_basics.speaker: Elder Guardian
tutorial_basics.text: Use Arrow Keys to move. Press Z to jump and Left Shift to run. Press C to dash. Open controls anytime with F1.

combat_tips.speaker: Elder Guardian
combat_tips.text: Press X for melee, S to guard/parry, and A to switch Yin/Yang stance. Press O to open the mission board if you lose track of objectives.

final_advice.speaker: Elder Guardian
final_advice.text: Explore every room, defeat enemies for health potions, and seek out the mission givers. They will test your skills!

hub_lore.speaker: Elder Guardian
hub_lore.text: This is the Central Hub, a safe haven for ninjas. From here, portals lead to different regions. Each holds unique challenges and treasures.

regions_info.speaker: Elder Guardian
regions_info.text: The Forest is for beginners. Then comes the Town, Caves, Castle, and finally the dark Sewers. Each region grows more dangerous.

progression_info.speaker: Elder Guardian
progression_info.text: Complete missions from NPCs to unlock new regions. Collect abilities, upgrade your gear, and grow stronger with each victory!

adventure_ready.speaker: Elder Guardian
adventure_ready.text: Your courage is admirable! Seek out the mission givers throughout the hub. They will guide you to your first trials. May fortune favor you!

intro.speaker: Siren of the Veiled Vale
intro.text: You stand at the threshold, Hallowed Ninja. I will be your first quest giver. Complete one trial and the mission chain will reveal itself.

choices.choice_text: Guide me through the first mission

onboarding.speaker: Siren of the Veiled Vale
onboarding.text: Act I is onboarding. Follow mission objectives in the tracker, interact with ! markers, and use O if you lose the chain. Start worlds stay compact so you can learn quickly.

control_reminder.speaker: Siren of the Veiled Vale
control_reminder.text: Arrow Keys move, Z jumps, Left Shift runs, C dashes, X attacks, S guards/parries, and A switches Yin/Yang stance. TAB shows the map. F1 opens controls.

greeting.speaker: Forest Ranger
greeting.text: Greetings, traveler! The forest calls for brave souls. I have missions that will test your mettle. Interested?

forest_info.speaker: Forest Ranger
forest_info.text: The Whispering Woods are ancient and full of secrets. Goblins infest the deeper groves, and a guardian spirit watches over all.

open_missions.speaker: Forest Ranger
open_missions.text: Excellent! Let me show you what needs doing...

greeting.speaker: Town Historian
greeting.text: Ah, a visitor! Welcome to our humble town. I preserve the history of this place. Would you like to hear a tale?

town_history.speaker: Town Historian
town_history.text: This town was once prosperous, a hub of trade. But darkness crept in, corrupting the mayor. Now shadows linger in every corner.

corruption_tale.speaker: Town Historian
corruption_tale.text: The corruption started small - whispers in the night, missing citizens. Then the mayor changed. His eyes grew dark, his orders cruel.

help_needed.speaker: Town Historian
help_needed.text: Brave soul! Seek the Town Captain. He leads the resistance and has missions to reclaim our home. Beware the corrupted guards!

greeting_act2.speaker: Elder Guardian
greeting_act2.text: You've returned... but you've changed. I can see the emptiness where your light once shone. The Veil Maiden took something precious from you.

choices.choice_text: I lost them... Yin and Yang are gone

acknowledge_loss.speaker: Elder Guardian
acknowledge_loss.text: Yes... I felt their absence the moment you arrived. Those gentle spirits were part of you. Their loss is real, and your grief is valid.

understand_pain.speaker: Elder Guardian
understand_pain.text: The Hollow Depths leave their mark on all who pass through. That emptiness you feel... it's the absence of connection, of light, of purpose.

choices.choice_text: How do I fill this void?
Tell me about the Hollow Depths

truth_about_loss.speaker: Elder Guardian
truth_about_loss.text: I cannot lie to you. The Yin and Yang you knew... they cannot return as they were. The Veil Maiden's power consumed them utterly.

not_your_fault.speaker: Elder Guardian
not_your_fault.text: No, young one. You fought with all your strength. The Veil Maiden's battle was designed for you to lose. She isolates, she manipulates, she takes.

not_everything.speaker: Elder Guardian
not_everything.text: You haven't lost everything. You're still here. You're still standing. And look around... others have walked this path. You're not alone.

path_forward.speaker: Elder Guardian
path_forward.text: The path forward is not one of vengeance, but of healing. Seek out The Lanterns - those who understand your pain. Together, you'll find strength.

choices.choice_text: I want revenge on the Veil Maiden

there_is_hope.speaker: Elder Guardian
there_is_hope.text: There is always hope, but it comes in forms we don't expect. Yin and Yang may be gone, but their essence... that can endure in different ways.

acceptance_path.speaker: Elder Guardian
acceptance_path.text: Understanding is the first step. Acceptance will come with time. For now, focus on rebuilding - yourself, and your connections to others.

veil_maiden_nature.speaker: Elder Guardian
veil_maiden_nature.text: The Veil Maiden isolates her victims, cuts them off from support, makes them dependent... then takes everything. She's done this before.

choices.choice_text: Has she done this to others?

shared_burden.speaker: Elder Guardian
shared_burden.text: Responsibility is not yours alone to bear. We all saw the signs, the hub emptying, the light fading. We should have intervened sooner.

choices.choice_text: What matters now is moving forward

the_lanterns.speaker: Elder Guardian
the_lanterns.text: The Lanterns are ninjas who've also faced the Hollow Depths. They understand isolation, loss, and the slow climb back to the light. Seek them out.

one_step.speaker: Elder Guardian
one_step.text: Recovery doesn't happen all at once. One step, one conversation, one small victory. That's how the light returns.

revenge_warning.speaker: Elder Guardian
revenge_warning.text: Vengeance born from pain leads only to more darkness. If you face her again, do so from a place of strength and healing, not hollow rage.

choices.choice_text: You're right. I need to heal first

encouragement.speaker: Elder Guardian
encouragement.text: That's all I ask. Take your time, reach out when you're ready, and remember - the hub may be dimmer, but it's not empty. We're still here.

essence_endures.speaker: Elder Guardian
essence_endures.text: Their memory, their impact on you, the love you shared - these cannot be consumed. In time, you may see them in new ways. As stars, perhaps.

mutual_understanding.speaker: Elder Guardian
mutual_understanding.text: We share this burden, then. And together, we'll ensure no one else falls victim to the Veil Maiden's manipulation.

depths_explanation.speaker: Elder Guardian
depths_explanation.text: The Hollow Depths is where the Veil Maiden sends those she breaks. A place of emptiness, where light struggles to exist. You escaped. That's remarkable.

choices.choice_text: How do I recover from it?

find_lanterns.speaker: Elder Guardian
find_lanterns.text: Some have returned to the hub. Others gather in quiet corners. Speak to them - they won't judge. They've been where you are.

lanterns_purpose.speaker: Elder Guardian
lanterns_purpose.text: They're not warriors, but supporters. They'll listen, share their stories, remind you that recovery is possible. That's a different kind of strength.

constellation_hint.speaker: Elder Guardian
constellation_hint.text: Just a thought. Sometimes what we lose doesn't disappear - it transforms. Becomes distant, but still visible. Still watching over us.

validation.speaker: Elder Guardian
validation.text: And you survived. That alone shows your strength. Now, let that strength rebuild what was lost.

take_your_time.speaker: Elder Guardian
take_your_time.text: Then wait until you are. Healing has no timeline. When you're ready, they'll be there. We'll all be here.

greeting_act3.speaker: Elder Guardian
greeting_act3.text: Look at you! The light has returned to your eyes. The Lanterns have helped you find your strength again. I'm proud of how far you've come.

choices.choice_text: I couldn't have done it alone
I'm ready to face her again
Thank you for believing in me

community_strength.speaker: Elder Guardian
community_strength.text: And that's the lesson the Veil Maiden never learned. True strength comes from connection, not isolation. You've rebuilt what she tried to destroy.

choices.choice_text: I want to help others now

rematch_discussion.speaker: Elder Guardian
rematch_discussion.text: Your resolve is clear, but remember - this battle isn't just about defeating her. It's about proving that light can endure even after darkness.

hub_restored.speaker: Elder Guardian
hub_restored.text: It does, doesn't it? The NPCs have returned, the portals glow brightly once more. The hub reflects your inner state - and you're healing beautifully.

choices.choice_text: But Yin and Yang are still gone
I'm ready for what comes next

always_believed.speaker: Elder Guardian
always_believed.text: Even in the darkest moments, I saw the spark within you. You just needed time to find it again. And you did.

lanterns_impact.speaker: Elder Guardian
lanterns_impact.text: They reminded you that you're not alone, that others have walked this path. That's the power of shared experience - it breaks the isolation.

choices.choice_text: I want to be a Lantern for others

pay_it_forward.speaker: Elder Guardian
pay_it_forward.text: And you will be. Your journey - from loss to recovery - will inspire others who face the Hollow Depths. You're proof that healing is possible.

choices.choice_text: First, I need to stop the Veil Maiden

battle_meaning.speaker: Elder Guardian
battle_meaning.text: The Veil Maiden is hollow herself - broken, manipulative, feeding on others' light. When you face her, you'll have a choice to make.

choices.choice_text: I'll destroy her for what she did

acknowledge_growth.speaker: Elder Guardian
acknowledge_growth.text: You are. Not just in power, but in wisdom. You understand now that strength isn't about never falling - it's about rising again.

ready_assessment.speaker: Elder Guardian
ready_assessment.text: You're ready now. You've regained your abilities, strengthened your resolve, and most importantly - you're not fighting alone anymore.

home_reflection.speaker: Elder Guardian
home_reflection.text: Home isn't just a place - it's the people, the connections, the sense of belonging. You've rebuilt all of that. The hub is whole because you are.

bittersweet_reality.speaker: Elder Guardian
bittersweet_reality.text: Yes. And that pain will always be part of you. But pain doesn't erase joy, and loss doesn't erase love. They coexist, as light and shadow do.

choices.choice_text: Is there any way to honor them?

hope_restored.speaker: Elder Guardian
hope_restored.text: Hope is the antidote to hollowness. You found it again, not through denial of your pain, but through connection despite it.

choices.choice_text: I want to face the Veil Maiden

meaning_in_pain.speaker: Elder Guardian
meaning_in_pain.text: Not all suffering has meaning, but you've chosen to give yours purpose. That's the mark of a true guardian.

choices.choice_text: I'm ready for the final battle

moral_choice_hint.speaker: Elder Guardian
moral_choice_hint.text: When you defeat her - and you will - you'll decide her fate. Destroy the threat forever, or offer her the redemption no one gave her. Neither choice is wrong.

choices.choice_text: How will I know what to choose?

vengeance_path.speaker: Elder Guardian
vengeance_path.text: Your anger is justified. She took everything from you. But remember - acting from rage makes you more like her. Act from strength instead.

choices.choice_text: Justice isn't the same as rage

redemption_path.speaker: Elder Guardian
redemption_path.text: Perhaps. She's broken, hollow, feeding on others because she has nothing within. Saving her won't bring Yin and Yang back, but it may break the cycle.

choices.choice_text: I'll decide when the time comes

confidence_response.speaker: Elder Guardian
confidence_response.text: Confidence is good, but remember - falling isn't failure. What matters is that you know how to rise, and who will help you when you do.

support_network.speaker: Elder Guardian
support_network.text: Not in battle - this is your fight. But they'll be here when you return, regardless of the outcome. You'll never face emptiness alone again.

wisdom_gained.speaker: Elder Guardian
wisdom_gained.text: You've learned what many never do - that wholeness comes from connection, not perfection. That's wisdom the Veil Maiden lacks.

carrying_memory.speaker: Elder Guardian
carrying_memory.text: As you should. They're part of your story now, woven into who you've become. Loss doesn't diminish love - it transforms it.

choices.choice_text: I'm ready to finish this journey

honor_memory.speaker: Elder Guardian
honor_memory.text: Live fully. Help others. Break the cycle of isolation. That's how you honor them - by being the light they represented.

trust_yourself.speaker: Elder Guardian
trust_yourself.text: Trust yourself in that moment. You've grown enough to make the right choice - whatever that choice may be.

vengeance_understanding.speaker: Elder Guardian
vengeance_understanding.text: I understand. The choice is yours to make, and I'll support whatever you decide. Just ensure it comes from your healed self, not your hollow one.

mercy_understanding.speaker: Elder Guardian
mercy_understanding.text: Your compassion, even for one who hurt you, shows how far you've come. That's the light the Veil Maiden could never extinguish.

choices.choice_text: I hope I can hold onto it

justice_distinction.speaker: Elder Guardian
justice_distinction.text: You're right. Justice seeks balance, while rage seeks only to inflict pain. Make sure you know which one drives you when the moment comes.

cycle_breaker.speaker: Elder Guardian
cycle_breaker.text: Then you understand the larger picture. This isn't just about you and her - it's about preventing future victims. That's true heroism.

final_preparation.speaker: Elder Guardian
final_preparation.text: The path to the Veil Maiden lies ahead. When you're ready, seek out the final challenges. And remember - whatever happens, you've already won by reclaiming yourself.

final_blessing.speaker: Elder Guardian
final_blessing.text: You already have. Now go, finish this journey, and return to us. The light awaits your victory.

final_advice.speaker: Elder Guardian
final_advice.text: Remember who you are - not the hollowed ninja who fell, but the one who rose. That's your true strength. Now go, and may the stars watch over you.

greeting.speaker: Samson
greeting.text: Aen. Good to see you standing. Most who come through here don't last a week. Walk with me.

choices.choice_text: How long have you been here?

sparring_pitch.speaker: Samson
sparring_pitch.text: Nothing serious. A sparring match. The body remembers what the mind tries to forget — and yours looks like it's forgetting fast.

choices.choice_text: I don't have time for games.

backstory.speaker: Samson
backstory.text: Long enough to know who belongs here and who's just passing through. You belong here. That's not a compliment. It means you've got work to do.

sparring_accept.speaker: Samson
sparring_accept.text: Good. The dojo. Sundown. Don't be late — and don't hold back. I want to see what you're actually made of.

sparring_refuse.speaker: Samson
sparring_refuse.text: Suit yourself. But you'll need sharper instincts than that when it counts. Find me when you're ready.

echo_greeting.speaker: Samson (Echo)
echo_greeting.text: You still move. Good. That's more than I dared hope, back then.

how_here.speaker: Samson (Echo)
how_here.text: Memory leaves echoes in dark places. You carved a deep enough groove in mine.

drift_acknowledge.speaker: Samson (Echo)
drift_acknowledge.text: I'm not angry. I never was. She made it so you couldn't see straight. I know that now. You didn't choose to disappear — you were made to.

shame_response.speaker: Samson (Echo)
shame_response.text: That shame kept you decent. Don't throw it away — but don't let it bury you either. Use it.

strength_find.speaker: Samson (Echo)
strength_find.text: Every step you take through this dark — that's me, at your back. Always was. Always will be. Now keep moving.

reunion.speaker: Samson
reunion.text: You came back. I knew you would. Took long enough.

waited.speaker: Samson
waited.text: I'd have waited longer. That's what brothers do.

doubt_response.speaker: Samson
doubt_response.text: But you did. That's the part that matters. The rest is just road.

fight_together.speaker: Samson
fight_together.text: Say the word. We do this side by side. Like it was always supposed to be.

greeting.speaker: Sophia
greeting.text: You're new. I've been mapping these paths for months and something keeps... resetting the cartography. The old routes refuse to stay fixed.

map_lore.speaker: Sophia
map_lore.text: This place has layers. Whatever happened here wasn't random. Someone — or something — doesn't want the true routes remembered.

choices.choice_text: What do you need from me?

map_request.speaker: Sophia
map_request.text: If you're heading out anyway — keep your eyes open for old map shards. Stone-pressed ones, pre-corruption. They hold the true routes.

grateful.speaker: Sophia
grateful.text: Thank you. Three to five shards — enough to reconstruct the primary route. They're older than anything else down here. You'll know them.

farewell.speaker: Sophia
farewell.text: I have to go, Aen. I know you've heard things about me recently. Most of it came from one source.

explain.speaker: Sophia
explain.text: She speaks first, loudly, to those who trust her. I won't win that argument by staying. But I want you to know — I chose to leave. For me. Not because of her. That distinction matters.

maybe.speaker: Sophia
maybe.text: If you get far enough. Keep climbing. I'll know if you do.

letter.speaker: Sophia
letter.text: Here. Read it when you're ready. It says what I couldn't say aloud.

return.speaker: Sophia
return.text: Still standing. I wasn't sure I'd see you again — not after what the Hollow Depths does to people.

almost.speaker: Sophia
almost.text: I know. But almost isn't the same as didn't. You're here. That's what the map shows.

star_ink.speaker: Sophia
star_ink.text: One last thing. I need Star Ink from the high Skyroad. A map I'm finishing — for you, actually. The route you'll need for the final ascent.

map_preview.speaker: Sophia
map_preview.text: Where the light comes from. And where you need to be when it does.

greeting.speaker: Marcel
greeting.text: Aen. You look like you've been dragged backwards through a ruin. Perfect. I need someone who can take a hit.

forge_guard.speaker: Marcel
forge_guard.text: Jenro and I need to gather materials outside the perimeter. The forge can't be unguarded — someone already tried to take the bellows last week. I'm asking you specifically.

payment.speaker: Marcel
payment.text: Your first weapon enhancement. I don't offer that to anyone who hasn't earned it. You'll earn it.

accept.speaker: Marcel
accept.text: Then it's settled. Defend what's ours. I'll be back before sundown.

echo_hammer.speaker: Marcel (Echo)
echo_hammer.text: That hammer. I left it there on purpose. Hoped it would find its way to someone who needed a reminder of what it means to keep working.

choices.choice_text: I found it in the dark.

broken.speaker: Marcel (Echo)
broken.text: Broken doesn't mean finished. Some things have to break before they get stronger. The iron knows that. You should too.

choices.choice_text: I feel like I've been breaking for years.

unbroken_will.speaker: Marcel (Echo)
unbroken_will.text: The will doesn't break, Aen. Not if you don't let it. And yours hasn't. I can see that from here.

smith_greeting.speaker: Marcel
smith_greeting.text: You made it to the Monastery. Took your time. Now — bring me ore.

greeting_response.speaker: Marcel
greeting_response.text: You're alive. That IS the greeting. Now bring me ore.

reforge.speaker: Marcel
reforge.text: That old blade of yours has carried you far. It deserves better. So do you. Hearthstone ore — from the deep side-level. One load. I'll turn it into something worth carrying to the top.

choices.choice_text: Will it be ready in time?

in_time.speaker: Marcel
in_time.text: I haven't missed a deadline in thirty years. Get the ore.

greeting.speaker: Hazel
greeting.text: Hello. You look cold. Are you cold? It doesn't matter — I can help either way.

gentle_persist.speaker: Hazel
gentle_persist.text: You don't have to be 'fine' here. That's the point of this place. What do you actually need?

lantern_work.speaker: Hazel
lantern_work.text: Lantern cloth. It distributes warmth gently, slows things down a little. I have enough for a small weave — but I need silk-thread moss and cloud reed. Low-threat gathering. Nothing dangerous.

grateful.speaker: Hazel
grateful.text: Thank you. You carry enough weight already — let me carry a little of yours for a change.

cloth_echo.speaker: Hazel (Echo)
cloth_echo.text: That piece of cloth. I left it in a place where someone who needed it would find it. I'm glad it was you.

choices.choice_text: It was in the darkest part.
Why did you leave it here?

fade.speaker: Hazel (Echo)
fade.text: I couldn't stay in the Heights. She made the air there... difficult. But leaving wasn't abandoning you. I hope you understand that. I had to choose myself.

choices.choice_text: I didn't understand then. I do now.

worth.speaker: Hazel (Echo)
worth.text: You never stopped being worth saving. I want you to hear that clearly. From me. Not as an echo — as a fact.

final_lantern.speaker: Hazel
final_lantern.text: I've been working on this one for a long time. It's not for light — not really. It's for remembering. That you were here. That you kept going.

name_it.speaker: Hazel
name_it.text: I haven't named it yet. I thought you might want to.

almost_done.speaker: Hazel
almost_done.text: Almost. There's a rare woven-root in the high challenge level — only one place it grows. Bring it back and I'll finish the Beacon Lantern before you ascend.

be_careful.speaker: Hazel
be_careful.text: Please be. You've come too far to lose yourself now.

greeting.speaker: Linzi
greeting.text: You've come far, wanderer. The Veiled Vale has use for those who persist. I can make this easier for you.

offer.speaker: Linzi
offer.text: Only to guide you. The paths here are treacherous — they shift, they lie. Without someone who knows the Vale, you'll wander until you're hollow.

accept_guide.speaker: Linzi
accept_guide.text: Good. Stay close. Don't ask too many questions. The Vale rewards trust.

soft_warning.speaker: Linzi
soft_warning.text: Those who wander alone here tend to become... lost. Remember this choice. I'm always here when you reconsider.

echo.speaker: Shadow Echo
echo.text: You weren't alone... why did you walk away? I couldn't reach you.

echo.speaker: Shadow Echo
echo.text: I wanted to help... but she turned your eyes from me.

echo.speaker: Shadow Echo
echo.text: You pushed so hard... until you broke. But the will doesn't have to.

echo.speaker: Shadow Echo
echo.text: You never stopped being worth saving.
